Finished in the top 8% of 3,100 teams with a LightGBM + XGBoost ensemble
Thesis: Bayesian hierarchical models for small-area estimation, written in R

jd_text:
Machine Learning Engineer – Clinical Prediction
Mendwell Health | Boston, MA or Remote (US) | Full-time

About Mendwell
Mendwell builds early-warning models that help 140 partner hospitals spot patients at risk of sepsis, deterioration and 30-day readmission. Our models score more than 2 million inpatient encounters a year, and our nurse-first alert design has cut alert fatigue at partner sites by roughly a third.

What you'll do
• Train, validate and deploy deep learning and gradient-boosted models on EHR data (vitals, labs, medications and clinical notes)
• Build and maintain feature pipelines over clinical data in Spark on Databricks
• Check every model for calibration and bias across patient subgroups before it reaches a hospital
• Monitor models in production for drift and data quality issues, and retrain them through MLflow
• Work with our clinicians and hospital IT teams to turn model output into alerts people trust
• Follow HIPAA and our SOC 2 controls in everything you build

Minimum Qualifications
• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience
• 4+ years building and shipping machine learning models in production
• Strong Python and SQL
• Experience with PyTorch (required) and gradient-boosting libraries such as XGBoost or LightGBM
• Experience working with clinical data, for example EHR, claims or registry data
• Working knowledge of HIPAA and safe handling of PHI

Preferred Qualifications
• FHIR or HL7 experience
• NLP on clinical notes
• Experience with model fairness and calibration methods
• Publications or talks in ML for health

Benefits
• Salary range: $170,000 – $205,000 base, plus equity and an annual bonus
• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage
• 401(k) with a 5% match
• 20 days PTO, plus the week between Christmas and New Year's off
• $3,000 annual professional development budget

Mendwell Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

expectations.trap_notes: CCPA opt-out work is consumer ad privacy, not health-data compliance; don't map it to the JD's regulation. The TensorFlow/Keras hackathon classifier is an unshipped prototype, not the JD's deep learning framework and not production deep learning. All experience is adtech and media with no clinical or patient data, so don't say 'healthcare-adjacent'. Keep the Brightwave end date at 2026-07; don't hide the layoff with 'Present'. 3B bid requests a day is scoring volume, not users. Title is Data Scientist II, not ML Engineer.
